title: Attention Bias Modification Treatment for Major Depressive Disorder in Adolescents
brief_summary: In this study, we test whether a two-week 8-session neutral attention bias modification (ABM) training and a two-week 4-session positive ABM could reduce depressive symptoms relative to placebo controls in adolescents with major depressive disorder at posttraining and follow-ups during one year.
condition: Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode, Unspecified
